title: Models
subtitle: One public name, many providers. Load-balance across healthy endpoints.
formTitle: {mode, select, edit {Edit model} add {Add model} other {Add model}}
formSubmit: {mode, select, save {Save} create {Add model} other {Add model}}
addHint: Pick a provider and the upstream model id. Routing options are optional.
empty: Add a public name clients can send as model.
needProvider: Connect a <providers>provider</providers> first, then add a public model name.

fields.aliasHint: Saved in lowercase. Clients can send any capitalization, such as Gemma-3-27B or gemma-3-27b.
fields.enabledHint: When off, the model is hidden from /v1/models and requests to it fail with model not found, also as a fallback. Settings are kept.

billingModeLabel: {mode, select, average {Average of endpoints} routed {Routed provider} custom {Custom price} other {{mode}}}
billingModeHint: {mode, select, average {Bill the average of endpoint prices. That average is the floor: a cheaper route still bills the average.} routed {Bill the endpoint that served the request.} custom {Bill your own price per 1k tokens, whichever endpoint serves the request.} other {}}
billingSummary: {mode, select, custom {{input, number, price} in · {output, number, price} out / 1k{windows, plural, =0 {} one { · # time window} other { · # time windows}}} average {Average of endpoints} routed {Routed provider} other {{mode}}}
priceHint: Billed to keys, users, teams, and budgets instead of the endpoint cost. Cache and service-tier rules still apply.
priceInvalid: Enter a price of 0 or more.
strategyLabel: {strategy, select, weighted_random {Weighted random} least_inflight {Least in-flight} cost_lowest {Lowest cost} fast {Fast (lowest latency)} priority {Priority} auto {Auto (cost)} other {{strategy}}}

toasts.saved: {mode, select, edit {Model updated} add {Model added} other {Model added}}

schedule.title: Time-based prices
schedule.hint: Bill a different price during set hours, for example cheaper at night. Outside these windows the price above applies. A window may run past midnight, such as 22:00 to 06:00.
schedule.overlap: Two windows cover the same time. Adjust their start or end.
schedule.timeZoneHint: Window times follow this time zone, including daylight saving changes. A request is priced by when it started.
